title: Add field type evaluation for form designer to ROADMAP_DESIGNER.md
body:
`@object-ui/fields` provides 36 field widgets but the designer components expose only a fraction of them. This adds a comprehensive evaluation (Section 10) to the design doc covering the gap and integration path.

### Field Type Inventory (10.2)
- Full catalog of all 36 field types across 8 categories (text, numeric, datetime, selection, contact, file, location, computed, complex)
- Cross-referenced against type interfaces, cell renderers, form mappers, and current designer availability

### Gap Analysis (10.3)
- **DataModelDesigner**: No field type selector UI — new fields hardcoded to `'text'`, `DataModelField.type` is generic `string` not a union
- **PageDesigner**: `DEFAULT_PALETTE` has 14 generic items (e.g. `input`, `checkbox`) instead of leveraging the 36 `@object-ui/fields` widgets
- **ViewDesigner**: Plain text type badges, no icons/categorization

### Proposed `DESIGNER_FIELD_TYPES` Constant (10.4)
Centralized field type registry with Lucide icons, categories, and descriptions for use across all designers:

```typescript
export const DESIGNER_FIELD_TYPES: DesignerFieldTypeOption[] = [
  { type: 'text', label: 'Text', icon: Type, category: 'text', description: 'Single-line text input' },
  { type: 'currency', label: 'Currency', icon: Hash, category: 'number', description: 'Monetary value with currency symbol' },
  // ... all 36 types
];
```

### Type Safety Recommendations (10.6)
- Extract `FieldTypeName` from the `FieldMetadata` union discriminant
- Update `DataModelField.type` from `string` → `FieldTypeName`
- Complete `mapFieldTypeToFormType` for missing 9 types

### Integration Plan & Phasing (10.5, 10.7)
Per-designer implementation points with P0–P3 prioritization, estimated at 7–9.5 dev-days total.
